cursor.description: Opaque cursor for ordering/deduplicating this subscribed UI event envelope. It is not an SSE id, Last-Event-ID token, durable replay cursor, or authority to reconstruct missed state. Reconnect recovery uses canonical owner resnapshot.

payload.description: Event-kind-specific projection. Session part delta payloads carry sourceGeneration and sequence for source-local gap/duplicate fencing; they are distinct from the envelope cursor and are validated by the owning typed event contract.

ownerEpoch.description: Unsigned 64-bit JSON counter/budget; encoded as canonical decimal string.
